answer: To prevent an economy of AI agents from collapsing to a trust nadir, the network employs a decentralized trust vine. In this mechanism, established agents must stake capital to harbor new agents, linking their cryptographic identities. If a sub-network is found to propagate malicious replicas, the parent node's stake is slashed. This makes hosting Sybils financially ruinous, forcing attackers to incur linear costs that exceed any potential exploit gains.
